about: Which stop pattern of a MÁV train the card draws between two stations: pickMavVariant (src/lib/gtfs.js) and the Python audit's pick_variant (scripts/mav_variant.py) must give the same answer for each case. variants are [polyline, [station index, ...]] as in mav-index.json.gz; expect is null (no route from the index) or the chosen variant's position in variants with the boarding and alighting positions in its station list (-1: none). Station names are ones both name matchers agree on.

cases.name: the longest pattern serving both stations in order; BKK's name for the alighting station
a later pattern when the first one does not reach the alighting station
another train's number (8714 Székesfehérvár–Siófok): boarding station only, towards another terminus, is no match
without the alighting station, the pattern ending at the row's headsign
the headsign as the boarding station itself (the pattern's last stop) is no match
the other direction only: the alighting station comes before the boarding one
no pattern serves the boarding station
case and accents do not matter
without a boarding station, the first pattern
without a boarding station and without patterns, nothing
